name: Bhivpuri Waterfall
tagline: An easy, train-accessible monsoon waterfall near Karjat
seoTitle: Bhivpuri Waterfall Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Bhivpuri Waterfall near Karjat — the easiest, most train-accessible monsoon waterfall near Mumbai.

seasons.label: Oct – May
seasons.sub: Reduced to minimal flow outside monsoon

routeOptions.name: From Bhivpuri Road station
routeOptions.notes: Short, easy walk — good beginner outing, directly reachable by Mumbai's suburban rail line.

safety.intro: Bhivpuri is about as low-effort as this list gets, but it still draws heavy monsoon crowds and has the usual plunge-pool caution.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Very accessible by train from Mumbai — check the local train timetable

cards.title: On the trail
items: Rocks near the base are slippery
Avoid swimming close to the falling water's direct impact zone

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Easy, well-trafficked, good beginner solo outing
Still keep basic water-safety caution near the pool
